about: VFX-LAB-2+3 · the card registry. A card manifests only if it has an entry here (and is a Hero or Unit, A2). ladderExempt: true takes the card off the rarity duration ladder — ruling A3 grants that to the pilot alone. LAB-4d · defaults: the tuning every card inherits unless it carries its own — tempo (a card's manifest may set its own) and fizzle_ms (a faction's exit preset may set its own). Owner ruling 2026-09-13: 0.6× and 1500 ms. LAB-6: a card entry may also name itself (name, type, rarity, faction) and its exit ('faction' = its faction's preset in data/factionfx.json) — documentation only; a play reads type, rarity and faction from the board. LAB-7: every entry is keyed by the card's ENGINE id; "fixture" names its fixtures (fixtures/<fixture>_seat0/1.json) and "art" its card frame (copied into art/ by tools/copy_runtime.js) — the lab page builds its Play buttons and board art from these.
